response.sql:
WITH city_qualifying_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location as city,
    COUNT(q.qualifyId) as qualifying_count
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(qualifying_count) as total_qualifying,
    COUNT(*) as num_cities
  FROM city_qualifying_counts
)
SELECT 
  cqc.city,
  cqc.qualifying_count,
  CAST(cqc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_qualifying as share,
  (CAST(cqc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_qualifying) - (1.0 / s.num_cities) as above_average
FROM city_qualifying_counts cqc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE CAST(cqc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_qualifying > 1.0 / s.num_cities
ORDER BY cqc.city;

assumptions.assumption: The 'city' is circuits.location field, which identifies the circuit's location/city.
'Share of qualifying' means the count of qualifying records (one per driver per race) for that city divided by total qualifying records across all cities.
The 'average city share' is 1/(number of cities with qualifying), representing equal distribution if all cities had identical qualifying activity.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Share of qualifying' could mean the proportion of that city's races with any qualifying session (races with qualifying / total races in the city), compared against the average such proportion across cities.
alternatives.sql:
WITH city_data AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location as city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.qualifyId IS NOT NULL THEN r.raceId END) as qualifying_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) as total_races
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(CAST(qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / total_races) as avg_share
  FROM city_data
)
SELECT 
  cd.city,
  cd.qualifying_count,
  CAST(cd.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / cd.total_races as share,
  (CAST(cd.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / cd.total_races) - s.avg_share as above_average
FROM city_data cd
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE CAST(cd.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / cd.total_races > s.avg_share
ORDER BY cd.city;
